statement: Capping multiplicities gives a uniform set of reversible generators for products from a fixed set of connected factors
depends_on: Filtered homotopy colimits commute with homotopy groups; retract closure
notes: Does not establish that arbitrary interval generators have this product form; set-generation is in the reversible sense, with no extra accessibility assertion.

statement: A primary countable product of lower-class finite Postnikov sections reaches the upper endpoint
depends_on: A34.2; Serre classes theorem; BHH Lemma7.2.4; Kerodon coskeleton; ultrafilter retraction; Moore telescope
notes: Y=product P_n M(F_p,2) remains primary and retracts onto M; every proper interval class fails countable-product closure even when the total product stays primary. No principal-question movement or novelty claim.
